title: Unique evaluation-normalized extension of positive finite Tate comparisons
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P of [def-pur-conventions], a natural number n with P.level=n+1, the finite coefficient ring A=O_E/(varpi_E^(n+1)), and a proof that ell^(n+1) annihilates A. For every k-scheme X with structure morphism a, write L_X(r) and M_X(r) for the signed etale and pro-etale A-module sheaves, and nu_X for site comparison, as defined in [def-pur-signed-twist-site-transport-data]. Let b_X(j):nu_X^*L_X(j) ≅ M_X(j), j≥0, satisfy the specified root-tensor normalization [lem-amb-finite-tate-site-descent]. There is a unique family q_X(r):nu_X^*L_X(r) ≅ M_X(r), for all integers r and all X,a, agreeing with b_X(j) at every nonnegative j, such that for every d≥1, etale object U, pro-etale object W over U, local functional phi in L_X(-d)(U) and x in L_X(d)(U), evaluation of q_X(-d)(nu^*phi) on q_X(d)(nu^*x) equals q_X(0)(nu^*(phi(x))). Here pulled sections use the actual adjunction unit followed by restriction, and the evaluations are precisely the fixed pairings in the cited definition. Only this dual-extension result is asserted.

proof.text:
For $d>0$ set $P=L_X(d)$ and $Q=A_X(d)$, and $t=q^+_{X,d}$. The comparison site inclusion preserves finite limits and coverings [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and $
u_X^{-1}A_{X_{\mathrm{et}}}\cong A_{X_{\mathrm{proet}}}$ as ring sheaves, so that $
u_X^*$ on $A$-modules is $
u_X^{-1}$ [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact](1). Apply [lem-pur-signed-line-derived-base-change] to this line and $t$ (only its degree $-1$ clause is needed). Equivalently, use the evaluation-defined isomorphism $\delta_{
u_X,P}$ of [lem-pur-ringed-site-finite-free-dual-pullback] and put
$$q_{X,-d}=(t^{-1})^\vee\delta_{
u_X,P}.$$
Thus a pulled functional $\phi$ is sent to the functional whose value on $t(w)$ is the pulled value $\phi(w)$. This proves precisely the displayed evaluation equation, invertibility and uniqueness. Locally, if $e_d$ is a basis of $P$ and $f_d=t(e_d)$, the map sends $e_d^\vee$ to $f_d^\vee$. These formulas refer to the actual sheaf duals, not to a chosen abstract inverse line.

lean.statement:
theorem signedTwistEvaluationExtension (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (hlevel : P.level = n + 1)
    (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : P.signedSiteCoefficient n) = 0)
    (b : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (_a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (k : ℕ),
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (P.signedSiteCoefficient n)) X).obj
        (P.signedSiteEtale n hA X (k : ℤ)) ≅ P.signedSitePro n X (k : ℤ))
    (hb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (k : ℕ),
      IsFiniteTateSiteComparison P.coefficients.l P.extension n X n hA k (b X a k)) :
    ∃! q : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (_a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (r : ℤ),
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (P.signedSiteCoefficient n)) X).obj
        (P.signedSiteEtale n hA X r) ≅ P.signedSitePro n X r,
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (k : ℕ),
        q X a k = b X a k) ∧ P.SignedSiteEvaluation n hA q
